```python
import cv2
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import pytesseract

img_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/df6561b2-7ee5-4540-baab-5095f742716a.png"
img = cv2.imread(img_path)
hsv = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)

# Red mask (two ranges due to hue wrap)
lower_red1 = np.array([0, 120, 70])
upper_red1 = np.array([10, 255, 255])
lower_red2 = np.array([170, 120, 70])
upper_red2 = np.array([180, 255, 255])
mask_red = cv2.inRange(hsv, lower_red1, upper_red1) | cv2.inRange(hsv, lower_red2, upper_red2)

# Green mask
lower_green = np.array([35, 120, 70])
upper_green = np.array([85, 255, 255])
mask_green = cv2.inRange(hsv, lower_green, upper_green)

red_only = cv2.bitwise_and(img, img, mask=mask_red)
green_only = cv2.bitwise_and(img, img, mask=mask_green)

# OCR helper
def ocr_numbers(bgr_img):
    rgb = cv2.cvtColor(bgr_img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
    pil_img = Image.fromarray(rgb)
    text = pytesseract.image_to_string(pil_img, config='--psm 6')
    tokens = [t for t in text.replace(',', ' ').split() if t.isdigit()]
    return tokens

red_tokens = ocr_numbers(red_only)
green_tokens = ocr_numbers(green_only)
print("Red OCR tokens:", ' '.join(red_tokens))
print("Green OCR tokens:", ' '.join(green_tokens))
```
